fireArrows.name: Fire
fireArrows.description: Attacks leave brief ground fire and burn — enough to ignite oil puddles.

empArrows.name: Hexing
empArrows.description: Hits hex the target: its talents shut off and it moves 40% slower for 3.5s. Golden Aura / Sunstone shrug it off.

doubleShot.name: Twin Shot
doubleShot.description: Fires 2 projectiles per attack (+1 extra for volley weapons). +10% reload time.

aegis.name: Aegis
aegis.description: Shield: every unit gains a second health pool equal to its HP. Ranged hits drain the shield first; melee, fire and acid ignore it.

golden.name: Golden Aura
golden.description: Nearby allies resist tower debuffs and take 30% less damage for 30s. Wizards cannot convert them — the ray deals damage instead.

pitchBolts.name: Pitch Bolts
pitchBolts.description: Bolts splash oil on impact (does not ignite — pair with fire arrows or a Fire Bolt).

wideBlast.name: Wide Blast
wideBlast.description: Triples splash radius (grants splash to units without it).

skyBind.name: Sky Bind
skyBind.description: Can attack ground and air units.

skyLift.name: Sky Lift
skyLift.description: Lifts this unit into the air (combat flyer).

whirlwind.name: Whirlwind
whirlwind.description: Wider cleave — hits every enemy in a large disk around this unit.

skyhunt.name: Skyhunt
skyhunt.description: +50% damage and +25% range vs air units.

groundhunt.name: Groundhunt
groundhunt.description: +50% damage and +15% range vs ground units.

veteranAim.name: Veteran Aim
veteranAim.description: Each level above 1: +12% damage and +10% range (on top of normal veterancy).

regeneration.name: Regeneration
regeneration.description: Regenerates 2% of max HP per second in battle.

bloodfeast.name: Bloodfeast
bloodfeast.description: Heals for {{pct}}% of damage dealt (shared among living pack members).

carrionFeast.name: Carrion Feast
carrionFeast.description: On kill, heal this pack for 30% of the victim's max HP (shared among living members).

blightburst.name: Blightburst
blightburst.description: On death, leaves an acid puddle sized to this unit.

ruinousEnd.name: Ruinous End
ruinousEnd.description: On death, explodes for damage equal to this unit's max HP.

looseRank.name: Loose Rank
looseRank.description: At battle start, pack members push farther apart for 2s (3× personal space), then tighten again.

sunward.name: Sunward
sunward.description: Immune to hex (storm included) and tower debuffs.

massBinding.name: Mass Binding
massBinding.description: Beam or convert up to 4 enemies at once; each channel deals 18% intensity. −18% range.

soulRestore.name: Soul Restore
soulRestore.description: Converted units are restored to full HP.

galeGate.name: Gale Gate
galeGate.description: May reposition every deploy round without using Move Pack.

_auto.onKill: When this unit kills, raise a {{child}}
_auto.cleave: Hits every enemy within {{radius}} (around this unit)
_auto.emp: Hex on hit: talents off and −{{slow}}% move speed for {{duration}}
